simple.summary: רִבְלָה (Riblâh) means Riblah , a place in Syria First listed occurrence: 2Kgs 23 33.

definitions.full: H7247. Riblah רִבְלָה proper name, of a location 1. ׳ו in land of Hamath 2Kin 23:33 ; 25:21 = Jer 52:27 ; 39:6 ; with ה locative, רִבְ֫לָתָךְ 2Kin 25:6 , 20 = Jer 52:26 , also ('in land of Hamath') 39:5 ; 52:9 ; בְּרִבְלָ֑תָה 52:10 ; read רִבְדָמל֫תָה also Ezek 6:14 (for ׳דִּב ᵑ0 , see [ דִּבְלָה ]); ᵐ5 usually Δεβλαθα (also 6:14 ); modern Ribla on Orontes, Rob BR ii. 507 ; iii. 543 ff. Bd Pal 3. 405. 2 הָרִבְלָה (מִשְּׁפָם) Num 34:11 , on northeast border of land of Israel, certainly not so far north as 1 , but site unknown; ᵐ5 ἀπὀ σεπφαμαρ Βηλα , whence Di and others conjecture הַרְבֵּ֫לָךְ , but not Harmel , 8 miles southwest from ׳ו 1 (Wetzst ZAW iii (1883), 274 f. ), see Dr Hast. DB . רַבסָֿרִיס רַבמָֿ֑ג, see II. רַב . I. רבע (√ of following; see [ רָבַע ], רֹ֫בַע רֶ֫בַע, etc., below; also in ling. cognate).
